lines.intro: A fizzy lamb bounds out of the clover, bells jingling!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the lamb?

soothe.great: Fae hums a soft lullaby. The lamb settles into the clover.
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The lamb slows its bouncing.
soothe.miss: The lamb is too busy bouncing to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie plays tag through the clover. The lamb bounds after her!
play.good: Maddie wiggles a leaf. The lamb gives a happy hop.
play.miss: Maddie trips over a clover patch. The lamb keeps bouncing.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber over the clover. The lamb chases it!
cast.good: Sue twirls her bobber. The lamb watches with bright eyes.
cast.miss: Sue’s bobber snags on a stem. The lamb blinks.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles pinecones. The lamb hops in rhythm!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The lamb sniffs it.
juggle.miss: Jordan drops a pinecone with a thunk. The lamb keeps hopping.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy clover biscuit. The lamb munches happily!
lines.burst: The lamb bounds in a dizzy chain, sending clover petals everywhere!

burstResult.great: Fae hops over every flying clover petal!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the petals!
burstResult.miss: Poof! Fae gets a face full of clover.

lines.soothed: The lamb gives a tiny bell jingle. The fizzy spell melts away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a rest.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes away through the grass. The lamb keeps bouncing.
